bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This first-year kitten shots plan sequences doses against stopping after two kitten visits, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your cat.

Milestone labels on the first-year kitten shots table (8 weeks; 12 weeks; 16 weeks; ~1 year of age) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished first-year kitten shots kitten series is still incomplete.

faqs.question: Is this first year kitten shots schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual cat.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this first-year kitten shots schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to stopping after two kitten visits, and reset reminders as soon as the next first-year kitten shots due date is known.
